data.name: TinSpring Soccer
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

TinSpring Soccer is a faithful simulation of the tin-and-spring table game

you grew up playing — rebuilt from the rods up, with real material physics

instead of one generic pitch.

TEN BOARDS, TEN DIFFERENT GAMES

Every board is a different physical surface, not a different coat of

paint. A pre-war tinplate table drags and rebounds dully. A varnished ~1962

plywood table rolls far but rebounds soft. A century-old warped oak table

drifts the ball sideways on a long shot, so the same strike never lands in

the same place twice. A 2026 tournament board with a digital scoreboard is

the fastest and most predictable surface in the game. Ten boards, ten

distinct feels, one set of rules.

AN OPPONENT THAT PLAYS LIKE SOMEONE, NOT SOMETHING

The computer opponent's skill follows the strength of the team you're

facing — and so does its behaviour. Weak teams hesitate, shift their aim,

and visibly search for an opening before they strike. Strong teams commit

fast and don't second-guess themselves. You're not playing against a

difficulty slider; you're playing against something that feels like it's

deciding.

CHAMPIONSHIPS TO WIN

Take your national team through a full European Championship or World Cup,

group stage through to the final, against a real field of nations.

FOUR PLAYERS, ONE TABLE

Play locally with up to four players, taking turns on the same board — no

accounts, no lobbies, just pass the controller.

BUILT FROM CODE, NOT FROM A LIBRARY

Every board, every figure, every stitch of kit, every sound in this game

is generated procedurally — there isn't a single imported 3D model,

texture, or audio file in it.

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE

22 languages, including full native support for Simplified Chinese,

Japanese and Korean — not machine-translated filler, and not a font that

falls back to boxes when it hits a character it doesn't know.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Adjustable text size, a reduced-motion mode, and a high-contrast mode are

built in from the start, not bolted on afterwards.

COMING SOON

TinSpring Soccer is still in development. What you'll find here are real

screenshots — and, if included, a trailer — captured directly from the

running game, not concept art. There's no playable demo yet, and details

may still change before release. Wishlist to follow along.

data.short_description: TinSpring Soccer is a physics-driven metal spring table game with ten authentically different boards — from a warped ~1890s oak table to a floating hologram pitch — an opponent AI that plays like a real person, full national tournaments, and local multiplayer for up to four players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 (4 GB) / Radeon RX 570 (4 GB), Vulkan 1.2
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 12GB / RX 6600 XT 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
